ValidationRule.description: Allows users with the "Edit Partner Lead Source (Opportunity)" permission set to edit the lead source, but only from one lead source in the "Partner" lead source group to another.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Permission.Edit_Partner_Lead_Source_Opportunity, ISCHANGED(LeadSource), NOT(PRIORVALUE(Lead_Source_Group_Opp__c) = "Partner" && Lead_Source_Group_Opp__c = "Partner" ), NOW() - CreatedDate > 2/1440 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You may only change the Lead Source from one Partner value to another.
